name: glaude
description: Connects Claude Code to the Glaude desktop companion: a floating bubble that shows when Claude is working, done, or needs you, and lets you reply from it.

answerPermissions.title: Answer permission prompts in Glaude
answerPermissions.description: In manual mode, ask permission prompts in Glaude and in the terminal at once (Allow/Deny in Glaude, or 1, 2, 3 in the terminal); the first answer wins, and after 2 minutes Claude Code's own prompt appears. In auto mode Glaude never holds a call.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: glaude, claude or off. glaude: Glaude's own notifications with Reply, Answer and Allow/Deny buttons (needs Glaude in an Applications folder and its notification permission). claude: Claude Code's notification channel from /config, finished turns only, no buttons. off: none.
